nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balance holding token balances of every account; written in _tokenTransfer and burn.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances used by approve/transferFrom/_approve.
Private mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee controlling whether an account pays the transfer tax.
Public mapping(address=>bool) bots acting as a blacklist; written by blockBots and unblockBot without access control.
Private _tTotal = TOTAL_SUPPLY * 10**DECIMALS, total token supply returned by totalSupply().
Private _taxFee, the transfer tax percentage, initialised to INITIAL_TAX and changed by lowerTax.
Private payable address _taxWallet that receives the collected ETH via sendETHToFee.
Public _maxTxAmount, buy limit (tTotal/100 by default) checked inside _transfer and cleared by removeBuyLimit.
Private _owner set in the Ownable constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Private IUniswapV2Router02 _uniswap router interface used for swaps and liquidity operations.
Private address _pair, the Uniswap pair created in createUniswapPair and checked in _transfer.
Private bool _inSwap reentrancy guard flag set/cleared by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Private bool _swapEnabled enabling automatic token-to-ETH swaps inside _transfer.
Private _transfer(address from,address to,uint256 amount): applies limits, blacklist checks, performs the auto-liquidity swap and ETH payout, then calls _tokenTransfer.
Private _tokenTransfer(sender,recipient,tAmount,taxRate): computes tTeam/tTransferAmount and updates _balance state.
Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount) forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount) that calls _transfer and decreases allowance via _approve.
Private swapTokensForEth(tokenAmount) guarded by lockTheSwap; approves the router and calls swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp as deadline.
Private sendETHToFee(amount) transferring collected ETH to the tax wallet via _taxWallet.transfer.
Public onlyOwner burn(percentage) moving a fraction of the contract balance to address(0x1) via _tokenTransfer.
Public addToWhitelist(buyer) with no access control, setting _isExcludedFromFee[buyer]=true.
Public removeFromWhitelist(buyer) with no access control, setting _isExcludedFromFee[buyer]=false.
Public lowerTax(newTaxRate) with no access control that lowers _taxFee below INITIAL_TAX.
Public removeBuyLimit() with no access control that sets _maxTxAmount to the whole supply.
Public blockBots(bots_) with no access control that blacklists arbitrary addresses in the bots mapping.
Public unblockBot(notbot) with no access control that removes an address from the blacklist.
External onlyOwner createUniswapPair() approving tokens and creating the Uniswap pair through the factory.
External onlyOwner addLiquidity() adding the contract's ETH/token balance to the router and enabling trading.
Public swapForTax() without access control that swaps the full contract token balance for ETH.
Public collectTax() without access control that forwards the entire contract ETH balance to the tax wallet.
Empty receive() external payable accepting ETH from swaps and liquidity operations.
Ashiba constructor: sets _taxWallet, _taxFee, _uniswap, mints _tTotal to the contract and grants fee exemptions.
Private _approve(owner,spender,amount) validating addresses and writing _allowances.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): external caller input used for transfers, owner checks and privileged-looking functions lacking modifiers.
block.timestamp used as the swap and liquidity deadline, miner-manipulable.
External call _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(tokenAmount,0,path,address(this),block.timestamp) executed before balance bookkeeping completes.
ETH value transfer _taxWallet.transfer(amount) to an arbitrary payable address, executed before _tokenTransfer state updates.
External payable call _uniswap.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}(...) forwarding the whole contract ETH balance.
External call IUniswapV2Factory(_uniswap.factory()).createPair(address(this), _uniswap.WETH()) returning the pair address.
Parameter 'from' of _transfer: source account for balance reads and tax exemption checks.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer: destination account whose balance is credited.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer: user-supplied amount checked against _maxTxAmount.
Local 'contractTokenBalance' in _transfer holding balanceOf(address(this)) used as swap input.
Local 'contractETHBalance' in _transfer holding address(this).balance before the tax payout.
Parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth: amount approved and swapped through the router.
Local 'path' array in swapTokensForEth: [token, WETH] swap route.
Parameter 'sender' of _tokenTransfer: account whose balance is debited.
Parameter 'recipient' of _tokenTransfer: account credited with the net amount.
Parameter 'tAmount' of _tokenTransfer: gross amount before tax.
Parameter 'taxRate' of _tokenTransfer: tax percentage passed from _transfer.
Local 'tTeam' in _tokenTransfer: tax amount credited to the contract.
Local 'tTransferAmount' in _tokenTransfer: net amount credited to the recipient.
Parameter 'newTaxRate' of lowerTax: attacker-controllable value written into _taxFee.
Parameter 'bots_' array of blockBots: addresses blacklisted in the bots mapping.
Parameter 'notbot' of unblockBot: address removed from the blacklist.
Parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee: ETH amount forwarded to the tax wallet.
Parameter 'buyer' of addToWhitelist: address granted a fee exemption.
Parameter 'percentage' of burn: percentage divisor used to compute the burn amount.
Local 'burnAmount' in burn: computed token amount sent to address(0x1).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of _transfer inside the public transfer function.
msg.sender is used as spender and recipient in the public transferFrom function.
Constructor reads _msgSender() to initialise owner, tax wallet and minted balance.
Constructor writes _owner from msg.sender through the Ownable base constructor.
Constructor sets _taxWallet to payable(_msgSender()), making the deployer the tax recipient.
lowerTax is publicly callable and any msg.sender can write the tax fee with no onlyOwner guard.
removeBuyLimit is publicly callable and any msg.sender can lift the buy limit with no onlyOwner guard.
addToWhitelist has no access control, so any msg.sender can grant fee exemptions.
removeFromWhitelist has no access control, so any msg.sender can revoke fee exemptions.
blockBots is publicly reachable and any msg.sender can blacklist arbitrary addresses.
The 'from' parameter indexes _balance for the debit operation.
'from' of _transfer is forwarded as the sender argument of _tokenTransfer.
The 'to' parameter indexes _balance and the fee-exemption mapping.
'to' of _transfer is forwarded as the recipient argument of _tokenTransfer.
The user-supplied amount is forwarded as tAmount to _tokenTransfer.
The amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount in the buy-limit require.
contractTokenBalance is read from _balance[address(this)] via balanceOf.
The contract token balance is passed as the tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee when the threshold is reached.
tokenAmount becomes amountIn of the router swap external call.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, a miner-manipulable timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, a timestamp dependency.
The path array is supplied to the router swap call.
_taxFee (or 0 for exempt accounts) is passed as the taxRate argument of _tokenTransfer.
tTransferAmount is derived by subtracting tTeam from tAmount.
taxRate is multiplied into tTeam.
tAmount is the multiplicand used to compute the team tax tTeam.
The computed tTeam is added to _balance[address(this)].
tTransferAmount is credited to _balance[recipient].
The newTaxRate parameter overwrites the _taxFee state variable.
Every element of the bots_ array is written as true into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot is written as false into the bots blacklist mapping.
The amount parameter becomes the value sent by _taxWallet.transfer.
_taxWallet is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
The buyer parameter is written into the _isExcludedFromFee mapping.
percentage is multiplied into burnAmount = _balance[this]/100*percentage.
burnAmount is transferred out of the contract balance to address(0x1).
The result of createPair is stored into the _pair state variable.
_uniswap.factory() and _uniswap.WETH() provide the factory and token addresses for createPair.
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth, an external router interaction executed before balances are updated.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee, an outbound ETH value transfer before _tokenTransfer updates state.
_transfer finalises value movement through _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to authorise the router before swapping.
The permissionless swapForTax entry point calls swapTokensForEth, allowing repeated externally-driven swaps.
The permissionless collectTax entry point calls sendETHToFee, draining ETH to the tax wallet.
burn() performs the burn transfer through _tokenTransfer.
addLiquidity calls the external addLiquidityETH with the full contract balance before toggling state flags.
createUniswapPair performs an external factory.createPair call and stores the returned address.
createUniswapPair calls _approve for the router before creating the pair.
swapTokensForEth executes the router swap unsafe operation.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH value transfer unsafe operation.
Outbound ETH transfer to the tax wallet happens before _tokenTransfer writes _balance, enabling a reentrant state-inconsistency attack.
The external router swap can call back into the token (pair transfers/fallback) before balances are finalised in _tokenTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter only exists as a scoped argument of _transfer and is meaningless outside that core function.
The 'to' parameter is scoped to _transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
The 'amount' parameter is consumed only by _transfer's limit check and transfer logic.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local computed and consumed inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is a transient local read inside _transfer before the tax payout.
tokenAmount is the sole input of swapTokensForEth and drives the router swap.
The path array is constructed and consumed entirely inside swapTokensForEth.
The sender argument is scoped to _tokenTransfer and used for the balance debit.
The recipient argument is scoped to _tokenTransfer and used for the balance credit.
tAmount is the gross amount handled only inside _tokenTransfer.
taxRate is passed into and used only by _tokenTransfer.
tTeam is a derived local tax value used inside _tokenTransfer.
tTransferAmount is a derived net value used inside _tokenTransfer.
newTaxRate is consumed only by lowerTax before overwriting _taxFee.
The bots_ array is iterated only inside blockBots to populate the blacklist.
notbot is used only inside unblockBot to clear a blacklist entry.
The amount parameter is consumed only by sendETHToFee for the ETH payout.
buyer is used only inside addToWhitelist to set the fee exemption.
percentage is consumed only inside burn to size the burn amount.
burnAmount is a transient local computed inside burn for the transfer to address(0x1).
